profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished technical account manager and software engineer with 15 years of experience building relationships in customer-facing technical and software development roles, with a focus on observability tools, solutions, and methods.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Providing software solutions that will better serve the customers and employees of Southland Credit Union.

positions.title: Technical Account Manager
positions.description:
Implemented observability into customer applications across 10 accounts valued at a total of $5.5 million.
Facilitated a proof of concept aimed at migrating a client’s entire infrastructure to New Relic, and secured a $2.7 million annual contract by demonstrating the platform's observability capabilities.
Simultaneously conducted technical engineering tasks while assisting customers with code-related issues including implementing code optimizations, system enhancements, and training customers.
Managed customer code repositories and integration pipelines while troubleshooting as needed.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · C# · .NET Framework · Technical Sales Consulting · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core · TAM · Cloud Computing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Azure Cosmos DB · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Advised 12 law enforcement agencies to ensure customer satisfaction; migrated products to improve usability, and conducted training to improve customer retention and product adoption.
Built, deployed, and supported Azure Services used to run the Street Smart Application, onboarded new customers, and communicated with customers to ensure successful implementation.
Integrated customer data sources into feed engine application to consume and display in Street Smart.
Improved efficiency by upgrading Street Smart to support .NET Core 3.1 LTS and Elastic Search 7.15.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Databases · C# · SQL · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · .NET Framework · ASP.NET Core · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core · Cloud Computing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET MVC · Azure Service Bus · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Azure Cosmos DB

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
Improved site performance which led to a 30% increase in sales by orchestrating a website upgrade from EPI Server using Vue.js front end framework and C# backend to create an omni-channel experience.
Developed REST services to support iOS feature upgrades; increased user security and usability.
Worked on MSSQL database tuning to provide better query, view, and stored procedure performance.
Developed a warehouse delivery system using Flex and C# web service calls to Dynamics AX 2012.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Databases · C# · SQL · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · .NET Framework · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · .NET Core · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET MVC · ASP.NET · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Consulted on strategic integration of customer web service data using .Net C#, and processed it through SSIS packages, pushing the data via SharePoint web services to the appropriate list.
Developed web parts, content types, lists, and event receivers for SharePoint 2010.
Engineered design documentation and functional specifications for the Street Smart Application.
Assisted Operations team with production deployments and product troubleshooting.
Built and maintained an Azure Web App using Microsoft Azure and queue storage.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Databases · C# · SQL · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · .NET Framework · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Microsoft Azure · Cloud Computing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET MVC · ASP.NET · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: IT Communications Specialist
positions.description:
Liaised between technical staff and clients to ensure clear understanding and alignment across stakeholders.
Developed and supported a purchasing requisition and supportive service payments application.
Built a SharePoint intranet, and maintained Windows Servers and MSSQL Server databases.
Configured Adobe LiveCycle and SharePoint 2013 as a document management system.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Databases · C# · SQL · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · .NET Framework · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Developed a Real Time Air Analysis website using .Net development tools. Assisted in the development of the emission reduction incentive program using .NET. Developed and provided Microsoft Access reports. Developed Crystal Reports to help aggregate data for our users.
